}}'''Ishigari Terasian''' is the fat companion to King [[Paitar Nachiman]] of [[Arafel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Ishigari Terasian}}

==Appearance==
He is fat, unshaven and bleary-eyed. His clothers are usually rumpled and he generally looks like he has 'just roused from a stupor after a drunken feast'.

==History==
He is King [[Paitar Nachiman]]'s military advisor and general. He didn't get the position by merely being a good drinking companion.

==Activities==
He accompanies Paitar to a meeting with the rest of the Borderland Rulers.
